$comment: Developer machines. Layer 3 of 5. HEADLESS=false belongs in your .env, not here - this file is shared.
$comment_mfa: A dedicated Chromium profile, signed in once by a human: pnpm rpa mfa seed-profile. NOT the everyday Chrome profile - Chrome 136+ refuses to expose a debugging port for the default profile, so an existing session cannot be attached to. Gmail's basic HTML view was retired in January 2024, so this reads the modern UI and its selectors are a liability; gmail-api is the only headless-safe option and remains the production target.
